finalists.label: Inverted Papilloma
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores and mucin-containing goblet cells that are unique to this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Squamous Cell Papilloma
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as a 1-cm, nontender, exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque and papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of mucin-containing goblet cells and the specific histologic pattern of papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium are more decisive findings for Inverted Papilloma.
